title: Gov’t says funds, fuel supplies sufficient amid Middle East conflict

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The government has assured the public that it has enough funds and resources to respond to the continuing effects of the conflict in the Middle East, including rising fuel prices, transport costs and the needs of affected overseas Filipinos. Executive Secretary Ralph Recto made the assurance during the UPLIFT Committee meeting in Malacañang
